parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to R and in my app i'm trying to able the user select different data frames in a "selectInput" and then change the columns (dates) in this data frame selected through a sliderInput.

Here's my code:
Ui.r
      selectInput("indicador1", label = "Escolha um indicador para exibir:",
                                                          choices = list("RCV","RIM","RCM","EAC","RFE","RAD","TCD",
                                                                         "GCA","GCP","GOC","GCI")),
                                              sliderInput("Ano","Selecione um ano para exibir:", value = 2009,
                                                          min = 2009, max = 2011, sep = "")

Server.r

datasetInput <- reactive({
  ano   <- input$Ano
  dados <- switch(input$indicador1,"RCV" = RCV[, input$Ano],"RIM" = RIM[, input$Ano],"RCM" = RCM[, input$Ano], "EAC" = EAC[, input$Ano], 
           "RFE" = RFE[, input$Ano], "RAD" = RAD[, input$Ano], "TCD" = TCD[, input$Ano], "GCA" = GCA[, input$Ano], "GCP" = GCP[, input$Ano],
           "GOC" = GOC[, input$Ano], "GCI" = GCI[, input$Ano])
  
})


  output$chart2_3 <- renderChart2({
    n1 <- Highcharts$new()
    n1$title(text = input$indicador1)
    n1$chart(width = 980, height= 620, polar = TRUE)
    n1$data(x = c(RCV$Instituto), y = datasetInput(), type = "column", color = "#8fc74a", name = input$indicador1, label = input$indicador1)
    n1$xAxis(categories = c(RIM$Instituto))
    n1$legend(align = 'right',verticalAlign = 'middle',layout = 'vertical')
    n1$plotOptions(column = list(colorByPoint = FALSE))
    return(n1)
  })


When i put a specific value in the columns of "dados" e.g  dados <- switch(input$indicador1,"RCV" = RCV[,3],"RIM" = RIM[,3],"RCM" = RCM[,3], "EAC" = EAC[,3], "RFE" = RFE[,3], "RAD" = RAD[,3], "TCD" = TCD[,3], "GCA" = GCA[,3], "GCP" = GCP[,3],"GOC" = GOC[,3], "GCI" = GCI[,3])
  My selecInput works well, but in thi way i can't change the dates with sliderInput.

Best regards,

Filipe
